endorsements.quote: Data inputs should reflect the variable geographic distribution of thyroid cancer, including differences in incidence, genetics, and risk factors by age, sex, and ethnicity.
Without ongoing monitoring and periodic recalibration, AI tools may continue to make outdated or inappropriate predictions.

unlisted_practices: Include comorbidities, environmental exposures, and socioeconomic position as model variables rather than relying only on age, sex, and tumor size.
Use separate training and validation datasets rather than reusing the same dataset for both.
Ensure balanced sample sizes and demographic diversity across training and validation sets.
Include equivocal lesions in training and testing cohorts rather than only high-confidence or surgically confirmed cases.

screen.reason: This is a framework/roadmap paper proposing recommendations and best practices for developing and deploying representative AI models in thyroid cancer.
